---
title: Export Final True-Shape Network
subtitle: Reassemble the full node/link tables as drop-in replacements for the raw WFv1000 MasterNet shapefiles
description: Every raw model node keeps its full attribute record, with only its coordinate resolved through the same tiered snap cascade used for centroid connectors (main network snap -> CC/external nearest-point snap -> raw model coordinate fallback), so unsnapped or future node classes fall through safely without code changes. The final link table concatenates the model-attributed true-shape roadway pieces from 03_transfer_attributes.qmd with the centroid connector links from 02_create_link.qmd, dropping every lineage/QA-only column. Both outputs are written as ESRI Shapefiles using the field schema (names, order, DBF widths/precision) copied directly from the original MasterNet shapefiles, so they can be swapped in for the originals as-is.

## Setup

### Imports

```{python}
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import fiona
import geopandas as gpd
import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from _src.node_utils import resolve_node_coordinates
from _src.export_utils import conform_to_reference_schema, write_matching_shapefile
```

### Configuration

```{python}
# ── Filepaths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PATHS = {
    "in_network_nodes":       Path("_data/raw/WFv1000_MasterNet - Node.gpkg"),
    "in_node_snapped":        Path("_data/processed/nodes_snapped.gpkg"),
    "in_links_trueshape":     Path("_data/processed/links_trueshape.gpkg"),
    "in_centroid_connectors": Path("_data/processed/centroid_connectors.gpkg"),
    "schema_node_shp": Path("_data/raw/WFv1000_MasterNet_20260430/WFv1000_MasterNet_20260430_Node.shp"),
    "schema_link_shp": Path("_data/raw/WFv1000_MasterNet_20260430/WFv1000_MasterNet_20260430_Link.shp"),
    "out_node": Path("_output/WFv1000_MasterNet_20260430_Node.shp"),
    "out_link": Path("_output/WFv1000_MasterNet_20260430_Link.shp"),
}

# ── CRS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CRS_UTM = "EPSG:26912"  # NAD83 UTM Zone 12N — Utah (metric)

# The ArcGIS-REST-sourced raw layers rename the shapefile's EXTERNAL field to
# EXTERNAL_ (to dodge a reserved-word collision). Reverse it on export so the
# output schema is a byte-faithful match for the original .shp.
NODE_RENAME_MAP = {"EXTERNAL_": "EXTERNAL"}
LINK_RENAME_MAP = {"EXTERNAL_": "EXTERNAL", "ONEWAY_tdm": "ONEWAY"}
```

---

## Load Data

### Raw Nodes and Snap Results

```{python}
gdf_network_nodes = gpd.read_file(PATHS["in_network_nodes"]).to_crs(CRS_UTM)
gdf_nodes_snapped  = gpd.read_file(PATHS["in_node_snapped"], layer="nodes_snapped").to_crs(CRS_UTM)
gdf_cc_snapped     = gpd.read_file(PATHS["in_node_snapped"], layer="cc_nodes_snapped").to_crs(CRS_UTM)
gdf_ext_snapped    = gpd.read_file(PATHS["in_node_snapped"], layer="ext_nodes_snapped").to_crs(CRS_UTM)

print(f"Raw nodes: {len(gdf_network_nodes):,}")
```

### True-Shape Links and Centroid Connectors

```{python}
gdf_links_trueshape = gpd.read_file(PATHS["in_links_trueshape"]).to_crs(CRS_UTM)
gdf_centroid_connectors = gpd.read_file(PATHS["in_centroid_connectors"]).to_crs(CRS_UTM)

print(f"links_trueshape rows: {len(gdf_links_trueshape):,}")
print(gdf_links_trueshape["qa_status"].value_counts().to_string())
print(f"\nCentroid connector links: {len(gdf_centroid_connectors):,}")
```

---

## Part A — Resolve Node Coordinates

Every node keeps its full raw attribute record; only X/Y/geometry are
replaced, resolved through the same priority cascade `build_centroid_connector_links`
already applies (raw model coordinate as the base fallback, overwritten by
CC/external-station nearest-point snaps, overwritten in turn by the main
greedy network snap). Listing sources lowest-priority first, highest last,
means a future improved snapping pass or a brand-new node class is handled
by adding one more entry to `snap_sources` — no other code changes.

Coordinates are resolved for every raw node here, but not every raw node
survives into the final export — see Part C, which keeps only the nodes
actually referenced by the final link table.

```{python}
snap_sources = [
    (
        "ext_snapped",
        gdf_ext_snapped[gdf_ext_snapped["snap_resolved"]],
        "N", "x_snap", "y_snap",
    ),
    (
        "cc_snapped",
        gdf_cc_snapped[gdf_cc_snapped["snap_resolved"]],
        "N", "x_snap", "y_snap",
    ),
    (
        "network_snapped",
        gdf_nodes_snapped[gdf_nodes_snapped["snapped"].fillna(False).astype(bool)],
        "N", "snapped_x_round", "snapped_y_round",
    ),
]

coord_lookup, tier_lookup = resolve_node_coordinates(gdf_network_nodes, snap_sources)

print("Node coordinate resolution tier (all raw nodes, pre-filter):")
print(pd.Series(tier_lookup).value_counts().to_string())
assert len(coord_lookup) == len(gdf_network_nodes)
```

```{python}
node_ids = gdf_network_nodes["N"].astype(int).to_numpy()
xs = [coord_lookup[n][0] for n in node_ids]
ys = [coord_lookup[n][1] for n in node_ids]

gdf_nodes_resolved = gdf_network_nodes.copy()
gdf_nodes_resolved["X"] = xs
gdf_nodes_resolved["Y"] = ys
gdf_nodes_resolved["geometry"] = gpd.points_from_xy(xs, ys, crs=CRS_UTM)
```

---

## Part B — Build Final Link Table

Only fully model-attributed rows go into the replacement file — the
`qa_status == "matched"` roadway pieces and the centroid connectors. The
`qa_status` in {"endpoints_only", "a_only", "b_only", "neither"} rows in
`links_trueshape.gpkg` are real UGRC geometry with no model link behind
them at all (no valid A/B), so they cannot populate a schema that requires
model node ids and model attributes — they stay out of this replacement
file (they remain available in `links_trueshape.gpkg` for QA/inspection).

```{python}
gdf_matched = gdf_links_trueshape[gdf_links_trueshape["qa_status"] == "matched"].copy()
print(f"Matched roadway pieces: {len(gdf_matched):,}")
```

```{python}
with fiona.open(PATHS["schema_link_shp"]) as src:
    link_schema_props = list(src.schema["properties"].keys())

gdf_matched_final = conform_to_reference_schema(
    gdf_matched, link_schema_props, rename_map=LINK_RENAME_MAP,
)
gdf_cc_final = conform_to_reference_schema(
    gdf_centroid_connectors, link_schema_props, rename_map=LINK_RENAME_MAP,
)

gdf_links_final = pd.concat([gdf_matched_final, gdf_cc_final], ignore_index=True)
gdf_links_final = gpd.GeoDataFrame(gdf_links_final, geometry="geometry", crs=CRS_UTM)

print(f"gdf_links_final: {len(gdf_links_final):,} rows, {len(gdf_links_final.columns)} columns")
print(f"  = {len(gdf_matched_final):,} matched roadway + {len(gdf_cc_final):,} centroid connectors")
assert list(gdf_links_final.columns) == [*link_schema_props, "geometry"]
assert len(gdf_links_final) == len(gdf_matched_final) + len(gdf_cc_final)
assert gdf_links_final.geometry.isna().sum() == 0
```

---

## Part C — Filter Nodes to the Final Network

A node belongs in the replacement file only if the final link table
actually references it as an endpoint — the same referential-integrity
invariant the raw MasterNet itself holds (21,923 / 21,953 raw nodes are
referenced by at least one raw link). Pass-through/pseudonodes absorbed by
Stage 3's chain dissolve, and nodes touching only excluded link classes
(HOV/managed-access, unmatched leftover geometry), are no longer an
endpoint of anything in `gdf_links_final` and must not appear here — this
filter is a pure referential check against the final links, not a
hand-typed node-class list, so it stays correct as snapping/matching
coverage improves and more nodes become genuinely used.

```{python}
used_node_ids = set(gdf_links_final["A"]) | set(gdf_links_final["B"])
print(f"Nodes referenced by final links: {len(used_node_ids):,}")

gdf_nodes_used = gdf_nodes_resolved[gdf_nodes_resolved["N"].isin(used_node_ids)].copy()

dropped_tier_counts = (
    pd.Series(tier_lookup)
    .loc[lambda s: ~s.index.isin(used_node_ids)]
    .value_counts()
)
print(f"\nUnused nodes dropped: {len(gdf_nodes_resolved) - len(gdf_nodes_used):,}")
print("Resolution tier of dropped nodes:")
print(dropped_tier_counts.to_string())
```

```{python}
with fiona.open(PATHS["schema_node_shp"]) as src:
    node_schema_props = list(src.schema["properties"].keys())

gdf_nodes_final = conform_to_reference_schema(
    gdf_nodes_used, node_schema_props, rename_map=NODE_RENAME_MAP,
)

print(f"gdf_nodes_final: {len(gdf_nodes_final):,} rows, {len(gdf_nodes_final.columns)} columns")
assert list(gdf_nodes_final.columns) == [*node_schema_props, "geometry"]
assert len(gdf_nodes_final) == len(used_node_ids)
assert gdf_nodes_final.geometry.isna().sum() == 0
assert used_node_ids <= set(gdf_nodes_final["N"])
```

---

## Part D — Write Shapefiles

```{python}
write_matching_shapefile(gdf_nodes_final, PATHS["out_node"], PATHS["schema_node_shp"])
print(f"Saved {len(gdf_nodes_final):,} nodes → {PATHS['out_node']}")

write_matching_shapefile(gdf_links_final, PATHS["out_link"], PATHS["schema_link_shp"])
print(f"Saved {len(gdf_links_final):,} links → {PATHS['out_link']}")
```

---

## Summary

```{python}
print("=== Final Export Summary ===")
print()
print(f"Nodes: {len(gdf_nodes_final):,} total → {PATHS['out_node'].name}")
print(f"  ({len(gdf_nodes_resolved) - len(gdf_nodes_final):,} unused raw nodes dropped)")
print()
print(f"Links: {len(gdf_links_final):,} total → {PATHS['out_link'].name}")
print(f"  {len(gdf_matched_final):,} matched roadway (true-shape geometry)")
print(f"  {len(gdf_cc_final):,} centroid connector (TAZ/external/transit tether)")
```
